response.overview: The friendship between Adi and Sukri begins to fray because their children often fight. Dika and Eci compete with each other because they both sell jalangkote in the same alley. Another storyline follows the lives of students living in a boarding house. One of them is Aira, who is loved by Ellang, a water delivery man.
response.title: Jalangkote Rasa Keju
